placements.title: Pallasine checklist as the mandatory first-week onboarding gate
placements.frame: How does the Pallasine checklist's required first-week scope — accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift — and its supersession of the old wiki page establish it as the organization's onboarding standard?

The theme — standardized onboarding as an organizational practice — is a subject future envelopes could keep feeding.
